data.description: Ballet is a U.S.-based company dedicated to making crypto safe and accessible to all by specializing in beginner-friendly, self-custodial cryptocurrency cold storage solutions. Ballet’s secure, high-quality wallets feature a patented 2-Factor Key Generation process that requires no account setup, no passwords, and no seed phrases. To date, users worldwide are securing over $1 billion in crypto assets using Ballet wallets.
